offline_incomplete: Offline preparation is incomplete for this build and model.
offline_failed: Download interrupted. Connect to the internet and retry.
offline_storage: Not enough storage. Free space on this device and retry.
offline_unavailable: {model} is not available offline. Connect to prepare it, or select an available model.
offline_none: No pose model is available offline yet.
offline_update: An update is ready. Your workout stays on the current build until you finish.
offline_update_busy: Finish workouts in all open app tabs before applying the update.
wait_bicycle_crunch: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and knees raised. Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee as you extend the other leg, then switch sides in a controlled cycling motion.
wait_heel_tap: Lie back with knees bent and feet flat. Lift your shoulders slightly and reach sideways for alternating heels.
wait_forward_lunge: Step forward and bend both knees to about 90°, keeping your torso upright. Push through your front foot to return to standing, then switch legs.
wait_reverse_lunge: Step backward and bend both knees to about 90°, keeping your torso upright. Push through your front foot to return to standing, then switch legs.
wait_glute_bridge: Lie back with knees bent and feet flat. Press through your heels to lift your hips, then lower them.
wait_pogo_jump: Stand with feet hip-width apart. Bounce lightly from your ankles, keeping your knees soft.
wait_squat_jump: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Squat, jump up, then land softly with bent knees.
wait_dead_bug: Lie on your back with arms raised and hips and knees bent to 90°. Keeping your lower back against the floor, slowly extend one arm overhead and the opposite leg toward the floor. Return to center and switch sides.
guide_push_up: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders. Bend your elbows to lower your chest, then straighten your arms. Lowering and pushing back up counts as one rep.
guide_plank: Rest on your forearms and toes, with your elbows under your shoulders. Keep your shoulders, hips and ankles in a straight line. Hold this position for the timer.
guide_squat: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart. Bend your hips and knees to lower yourself, then stand tall again to complete one rep.
guide_squat_hold: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, then bend your hips and knees as if sitting back into a chair. Stay in the lowered position for the timer.
guide_sit_up: Lie on your back with your feet on the floor. Raise your torso until you are sitting upright, then lower yourself back to the floor to complete one rep.
guide_jumping_jack: Start with your feet together and arms at your sides. Jump your feet apart as you sweep both arms overhead. Jump back to the starting position to complete one rep.
guide_front_jack: Start with your feet together and arms at your sides. Jump your feet apart and raise both arms straight forward to shoulder height. Jump your feet together and lower your arms to complete one rep.
guide_burpee: From standing, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a high plank. Do a push-up, jump your feet back toward your hands, then jump up. Land on both feet to complete one rep.
tip_floor_side: Place the camera beside you, low enough to show your whole body from shoulders to feet while you are on the floor.
tip_squat_side: Turn sideways to the camera so your shoulders, hips, knees and ankles stay visible as you lower yourself.
tip_jumping_jack: Face the camera. Leave room above your head and on both sides so your hands and feet stay in the frame.
tip_front_jack: Turn slightly to the camera so it can see both feet move apart and both arms reach forward.
tip_burpee: Keep the camera still and use a side view. Leave enough room to show your whole body during both the push-up and the jump.
tip_alternating: Place the camera at an angle where both arms and legs are visible. One left-and-right pair counts as one rep.
tip_lunge: Use a side or slightly angled view with both feet visible. One step out and back counts as one rep.
tip_bridge: Place the camera to your side so your shoulders, hips, knees and feet are visible. One lift and return counts as one rep.
tip_jump: Keep the camera still and both feet in frame. Start standing so the tracker can see the floor level. The rep counts when you land.
camera_error: Camera unavailable. Allow camera access in your browser settings, close other camera apps, then retry.
model_error: The tracker could not start. Retry, or return to setup and select the other model.
invalid_link: Invalid workout link. Edit the circuit or open another link.
setup_privacy: Your video stays on this device. Camera access starts in practice, not here. When you start a workout in GameBus, your workout results are shared with GameBus.
setup_bad_number: Enter a whole number of {n} or more.
setup_too_long: This circuit is too long for a workout link. Remove a few steps and try again.
setup_invalid: Check the circuit: include an exercise and enter a valid target for every step.
setup_bad_link: This workout link could not be opened. Edit the example circuit below or try another link.
